bio.text: Quang Nguyen is a Republican member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 1, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.

According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Nguyen was rescued from Vietnam by the U.S. military a week before the fall of Saigon, graduated from Long Beach State, and worked for Northrop Corporation on the F-20 and F-18 programs.
The profile says Nguyen moved to Arizona in 2004, started a business, and was later elected to the Arizona House.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 1 (candidate-submitted statements)
